# NYC Taxi — Zone Detail

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Detailed statistics for a specific zone

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    z.zone,
    z.borough,
    COUNT(*) as pickup_count,
    AVG(t.trip_distance) as avg_distance,
    AVG(t.total_amount) as avg_fare,
    SUM(t.total_amount) as total_revenue
FROM trips t
JOIN taxi_zones z ON t.pickup_location_id = z.location_id
WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2019-04-29'
  AND t.pickup_datetime < '2019-05-29'
  AND t.pickup_location_id = 237
GROUP BY z.zone, z.borough
```
